title: Realme 17T design revealed in leaked live images
description: Late last month, a leak revealed the specifications of the upcoming Realme 17 Pro series. Now, a fresh leak has surfaced, offering a first look at the design of another expected model in the lineup, the Realme 17T. The leaked images offer a look at the front and rear design of the alleged Realme 17T. From the front, the phone appears largely identical to the outgoing Realme 16T, although the display bezels seem slightly slimmer, particularly along the bottom edge. title: Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm leaks: expect a big increase in battery capacity
description: It has been months since Xiaomi launched the 46mm Xiaomi Watch S5. Now, a leak reveals the specs of an upcoming 41mm version of the watch. The S-series runs a proprietary version of HyperOS instead of Wear OS, which means fewer features but longer runtime. The Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm has a stainless steel body that is slightly thicker than its predecessor, the Xiaomi Watch S4 41mm, at 9.9mm (up from 9.5mm). The upside of this is the sizable increase in battery capacity to 590mAh. That is close to double the 320mAh capacity of the S4 41mm. The battery will last up to 8 days of normal use or up...

title: Samsung's upgraded sleep apnea feature is now available on the Galaxy Ring and Watch9
description: Last week Samsung announced that the upgraded version of its sleep apnea feature was approved in Korea, following its FDA clearance in the US back in July. Today, the company has announced that the new version has become available in the US, including for the Galaxy Ring, which Samsung says is the first smart ring with an FDA-cleared, over-the-counter sleep apnea risk detection feature. The original version of the function, which received De Novo authorization from the FDA in February 2024, could only tell you whether signs of moderate to severe sleep apnea were detected. The upgraded one...

title: RedMagic 12 Pro brings its RGB liquid cooling and 185Hz screen to the global market
description: Back in mid-October, the RedMagic 12 Pro+ was unveiled in China, and RedMagic said at the time that it would also launch globally as the RedMagic 12 Pro. Today, the RedMagic 12 Pro is official for the rest of the world, and it keeps the RGB-lit liquid cooling and the 8,400 mAh battery of its Chinese counterpart. That battery is 12% bigger than the 7,500 mAh cell in the RedMagic 11 Pro, yet the new handset is thinner, at 8.5mm (vs. 8.9mm). title: Apple reports record quarter - iPhone and Mac sales are up, Services reach an all-time high
description: Apple announced a record $114.5 billion in revenue for the three months ending in September (which is Apple’s fiscal Q4) with a gross margin of 47.9%. Revenue is up 12% year-over-year and earnings per share are up 14% to $2.10. Tariff refunds helped boost Apple’s numbers by $0.05 per share and 1 percentage point for the gross margin. For fiscal 2026 (the twelve months ending in September), Apple posted a record-breaking revenue of $479 billion with a double-digit growth in earnings per share. title: vivo V80 FE listed online with Dimensity 7400-Turbo SoC and 7,000mAh battery
description: The vivo V80 debuted in global markets last month, and the company now appears to be gearing up to launch the V80 FE. The upcoming smartphone has surfaced on vivo’s official Philippines website, hinting at an imminent launch. vivo has also revealed the V80 FE's full specifications via the official online listing. The phone retains a design similar to the standard V80 but features one fewer rear camera. title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra to feature an upgraded Privacy Display
description: Samsung launched the Galaxy S26 Ultra earlier this year with a Privacy Display feature, and next year's Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra are rumored to have it, too. A new report by SamMobile corroborates those rumors and claims these two S27 series smartphones will feature an upgraded version of Privacy Display. The source also says that the Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will have enhanced display brightness, making their screens easier to read under direct sunlight. title: Oppo Reno17 and Reno17 Pro's specs, colors, and configurations leak
description: Oppo recently confirmed that the Reno17 series will launch in China this month. Ahead of the debut, a new leak has revealed the key specs, color options, and the configurations of the Reno17 and Reno17 Pro. In a now edited post on Weibo, tipster Digital Chat Station shared new details about the upcoming Oppo Reno17 series. According to the tipster, both models in the lineup will feature a 50MP periscope telephoto camera. title: Elon Musk's SpaceX may buy Boost Mobile to make Starlink into a full-fledged carrier
description: SpaceX has made no secret of its plans to turn Starlink Mobile into a full-fledged US carrier, and last month it bought more spectrum to help make that happen. What it still lacks is a ground network, and last week T-Mobile's CEO ruled out letting Starlink Mobile run on his company's network. Now, according to a new report, Elon Musk may have found a way around that problem, and it's called Boost Mobile. title: OnePlus Turbo 7 key specs leak, and it's a big step up
description: OnePlus launched the Turbo 6 in China back in January, and now a tipster on Weibo has shared the first details about its successor. According to the source, the Turbo 7 will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 6, which is still being refined, and OnePlus is allegedly vying to be among the first to launch a phone with it. The Turbo 7 is also said to continue OnePlus' push to bring a 200MP main camera and a 185Hz refresh rate (165Hz system-wide) to more of its phones. title: Motorola Signature 27 stars in hands-on promo video ahead of launch
description: While we wait for Motorola to fully take the wraps off the Signature 27, its next flagship smartphone, the company has partnered up with Danny Winget for an exclusive hands-on promo video showcasing the device in all its glory. You can see it below. The Signature 27 is confirmed to come in two colors, Pantone Coal Smoke and Pantone Capulet Olive, and to have Audio by Bang & Olufsen, as the company previously announced. title: Apple plans to refresh three iPads in the first half of 2027
description: Apple launched the iPad mini (2026) last week, with an OLED screen and the A20 Pro chip. If you were wondering about the rest of the lineup, Apple is allegedly planning a wave of iPad updates for the first half of 2027, according to a new report from Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. Three models will reportedly be part of it: a new entry-level iPad, an iPad Air with an OLED display, and a faster iPad Pro with a vapor chamber for cooling. title: New Samsung Galaxy S27+ certification confirms its charging prowess
description: The upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27+ showed up in China's 3C database with 45W charging support back in September, and now another certification is backing that up. A couple of safety certifications list the phone with a 15V/3A rating, which works out to 45W. Between them, the two certifications cover pretty much every version of the handset, from the global SM-S956B and the Korean SM-S956N to the US SM-S956U, the Chinese SM-S9560, and the SC-52H headed to Docomo in Japan. title: Google is experimenting with a status bar for Wear OS - here is what it looks like
description: Google is experimenting with a small but important change to Wear OS – adding a status bar, similar to Android phones. A test version of this feature was included in the Wear OS 7.1 canary emulator and the company is asking developers to try it out and send feedback. The feature will add a status bar that displays the current time and the most important status indicator at the top of the screen – if there are multiple status indicators, only the top priority one is displayed. title: Spotify reportedly wants up to $5 extra per month for AI covers and remixes
description: Back in May, Spotify announced a licensing deal with Universal Music Group for a new AI tool that lets fans create covers and remixes of songs from participating artists, and said it would launch this as a paid add-on for Premium subscribers. It didn't share a price or a launch date at the time, but now we have a better idea of both. According to a new report, Spotify is aiming to launch the service in the first quarter of 2027, possibly unveiling it around the Grammy Awards in February. title: Redmi M100 Pro launches with Dimensity 7300-Ultra SoC and triple-rear cameras
description: Redmi unveiled the M100 in China in August, featuring a Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset and a 7,900mAh battery. Now, the company has quietly launched the Redmi M100 Pro in the country. The Redmi M100 Pro is powered by the Dimensity 7300-Ultra chipset, paired with up to 12GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 256GB UFS 2.2 storage. It features a curved 6.67-inch AMOLED display that supports a 120Hz refresh rate and gets Gorilla Glass Victus 2 protection. The phone also comes with an under-display fingerprint scanner. title: Karbonn makes a comeback in India with Rebel and Rebel Pro
description: Indian smartphone brand Karbonn has officially made a comeback in the country's smartphone market with the launch of its new Rebel series, which comprises the Rebel and Rebel Pro. The 4G phones will be available to purchase online in India starting November 4. The Karbonn Rebel is powered by the MediaTek Helio G81 chipset and features a 6.75-inch LCD with a 90Hz refresh rate. The rear panel features a large horizontal camera island with three cutouts. However, Karbonn has only confirmed a 50MP primary rear camera, suggesting that the other two cutouts may be decorative. description: OnePlus has expanded its Turbo 6 series in China with the addition of a new variant, the Turbo 6Vs. The new phone is listed on the company’s official online store and offers similar specifications as the Turbo 6V. The only apparent difference between the OnePlus Turbo 6V and the new Turbo 6Vs is the color options. The latter is available in a new orange shade alongside a white option. title: Xiaomi 18 Pro series is going global this month
description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max debuted in China in September, with Xiaomi subsequently confirming plans for a global launch. The company has now begun teasing their international debut, offering a tentative launch timeline. In a social media post, the company confirmed that the Xiaomi 18 Pro series will make its global debut later this month. Notably, the phones were recently spotted on Italian retailer Epto’s online store, revealing their specifications, colour options, and European pricing. description: The Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 are the company’s latest flagship true wireless earbuds. They are a major overhaul of the previous generation Momentum True Wireless 4 in nearly every way, with the company claiming improved design, comfort, audio quality, noise cancellation, and microphone performance. And they also happen to be Sennheiser’s first wireless earbuds with user-replaceable batteries.
